# MIDI projection profile

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:profileMIDI`](gmeow-profileMIDI.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/profileMIDI>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md), [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Projection profile for MIDI. Lossy: no notation semantics, enharmonics, rests, tuplet structure, or work identity; per-note pitch 7.9 in MIDI 2.0 can carry microtonal cents.
